description:
Price an order before buying

What booking a plan, changing or renewing a subscription or buying add-ons would cost, with VAT, term and whether it is refused (`refusal`). Nothing is charged. Buy with `POST /billing/orders`.

kind.description: `subscription_book` a new plan, `subscription_change` another plan, `subscription_renew` the running term again, `addon` extra minutes or conversations.
